title: Dispatch request
description: WO-14b leg 2a. What the Conductor hands orchestra_dispatch — NOT the routed canonical order (registry/schemas/order.schema.json). order.schema.json requires requested_casting, author_family, review_policy and integrity_nonce, and dispatch() mints the nonce itself; a caller that could set those fields could pick its own casting or forge review policy. This schema is the input side of that boundary: it carries only what a human or Conductor actually knows before routing happens (the goal, the acceptance criteria, an optional casting override with a stated reason), and additionalProperties:false makes requested_casting/author_family/review_policy/integrity_nonce/implementation_author_family structurally unrepresentable here, not just discouraged. The router computes the canonical order (and mints the ticket) from a validated request plus live pool state.

task_id.description: If absent the runtime mints one.

tier.description: Builder-routed classes only; the router defaults it by class when absent.

override.description: An explicit Conductor casting override (e.g. Sol·high on deep). reason is mandatory and must be substantive, not a rubber stamp.

human_authored.description: The work under review was written by a human; the router sets author_family:"human" from this, never from a model's own assertion.

under_specified.description: The Conductor's own admission that the request is under-specified; feeds the Luna guardrail (never under-specified work to a bounded-tier Luna casting).
